front.title: Signed Handoff Context for Agentic Dialogs

abstract.t: When one agent hands a task to another, the receiver needs to know who handed it over, on whose behalf, through which earlier agents, and which prior context the work depends on. It needs to know the handoff is fresh and meant for it, and the sender needs a clear answer back. This document defines a small, transport-neutral handoff context: a signed offer, a signed status reply, and the chain of earlier offers that led to the current one, in CDDL for JSON and CBOR, with a lifecycle that maps to Agent2Agent task states. Each offer names the one before it by hash, so a dropped or reordered intermediate hop is detectable when the chain is carried. Prior context is named by digest only. The document is input to the agentproto working group's use cases and dialog-context work.
